plain: To soften; to calm or ease.

webster.text: To soften; to make soft or tender.

example.quote: The spirit of the master is abating, that of the slave is rising from the dust, his condition mollifying, the way I hope preparing, under the auspices of heaven, for a total emancipation, and that this is disposed, in the order of events, to be with the consent of the masters, rather than by their extirpation.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Notes on the State of Virginia, Query XVIII (Manners) (1802 ed.)
